source: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles, arXiv:2603.15569; reference impl state-spaces/mamba mamba_ssm/modules/mamba3.py
primary_thesis: The live selective scan does not compute the specified Mamba recurrence (rel-max-err 0.92 at the measured init Delta=0.705). The exact log-space fix costs 19.3 GB in Mamba-1's A=(d_inner,N) form but 19 MB in Mamba-2/3's scalar-A-per-head form, so migrating to SSD is what makes correctness affordable. Mamba-3 SISO on top is parameter-matched to +0.24% while giving 8x the SSM state. Screen by Stage-0 PPL, decide by report generation.
